items.title: Why Old Dominion and J.B. Hunt Stock Could Gain From Trucking Rule Changes
items.summary: Truck capacity is quietly being rewired as tighter federal enforcement on commercial licenses and safety, plus heavyweight legal rulings around broker liability, push more risk and responsibility onto the freight chain. That shift can squeeze small operators and reshape who wins freight contracts. For investors, this creates a rare moment where regulation and courtroom pressure may reward scale. This article explains that dynamic and highlights three large U.S. carriers affected by these...
